title: Passion, Prejudice and South Pacific: Creating an American Masterpiece
original_title: Passion, Prejudice and South Pacific: Creating an American Masterpiece
overview: A 95-minute, four-part documentary exploring the creation of the hit Broadway musical and 1958 film adaptation of South Pacific. Narrated by star Mitzi Gaynor, it dissects the real-world social themes, music, and production history.
